plan.notes: SOURCE: Official UND 2026-2027 Academic Catalog, Management (MGMT) program PDF, 'Four Year Plan - B.B.A. with Major in Management' (published Total Credits: 120-121); course titles cross-checked against the official BBA Management requirements page. CREDIT-RANGE NOTE: the freshman-spring free-elective slot is published as 2-3 credits; it is recorded here at 3 so the transcription sums to the published maximum total of 121. UND's own note: students must complete enough electives to bring total credit hours up to 120. Nistler College graduation requirements: 2.00 GPA overall and at UND, 2.50 GPA in major courses; at least half of business courses toward the major must be from UND.
